# Failing shader idioms (pattern descriptions only, no game code) — RX 7600 device, 2026-11-24 ~01:35Z

Offline translate over 26,148 programs. Before = 4c5545a + shader-gaps-combined; after = cf1f4d4 (+ stack/shader-fixes 9707daf + fork fix/sgpr-address-not-root).
- address in an SGPR that is no root parameter: 247 -> 206 (52 BVH compute pass; 196 voxelization GS remain, no GS stage translation yet, + 10)
- address not from a root parameter: 73 -> 92 (BVH now stopping at the next step)
- root UAV or typed root view: 0 -> 22 (BVH)
- unchanged: descriptor read only as data 405, scalar memory read as data 328, descriptor neither loaded nor built 298 (!! 9707daf's fix did not move it), lane mask holding lanes elsewhere 276, interpolation with computed barycentrics 207, packed input half 172, lane mask read as data 155, structured buffer of unknown stride 110, whole-wave section 51.
- compute: 1,706 emitted of 2,603.

## "descriptor read only as data" (04f90cb19f940759, 0753e7f1ebeb1681, 0926a680fc26dcba)
Table pointer = {table SGPR, 0}; s_load_dwordx8 of an image descriptor; image_store in an exec-masked tail block. Elsewhere in the same program the SGPRs of a just-loaded x8 descriptor are reused as scratch (v_readfirstlane, then s_and/s_lshl/s_or bit-packing, shared-exponent style). Hypothesis: value numbering ties the descriptor to a value later read only by scalar ALU.

## "lane mask holding lanes elsewhere" (04d46e7934e1fe24, 05b939a0705f27ed, 05ef21a2132db12d)
An exec-derived mask is saved into a VGPR lane (v_writelane), read back with v_readlane, then used as a mask again (s_andn2 vcc, exec, sM / s_and with s_cselect(exec,0) -> s_cbranch_vccnz or s_and_saveexec). SGPR spills through VGPR lanes.

## e30970f1727063fd (structured buffer of unknown stride)
x4 buffer descriptor read from a table, then two buffer_store_dwordx4 idxen at offsets 0 and 16 (32-byte elements). Stride only exists in dword 1 of the in-memory descriptor (heap-loaded case).

## 910b4be059bfb28f (mesh, "descriptor neither loaded nor built")
Waterfall loop over a non-uniform sampler held in VGPRs: v_readfirstlane x4, v_cmp_eq_u64 x2, s_and_saveexec, image_sample_lz, s_xor exec, loop back.

## 5e68767498c57eb6
Not found in shaders.rpf or XboxBvhBuilder.dll with the hash filter; probably another DLL. (Device added per-container hash + VICTORY_SHADER_HASHES filter to shader-info, commit 2f3c4b2.)

## Indirect "prepare failed (compute false, mesh false)"
These are RECTANGLE LIST draws (topology 17): direct draws expand rects on the CPU, indirect ones never do. 64-104 per world frame, maybe full-screen/tile passes (lighting?). Device session is implementing GPU expansion of indirect rect lists.

## 4e35b816f2f91d68 / b3ba0ef9ee352720 (VS, "scalar memory read as data", fail at 0x424 / 0x42c) — ~1,700-instruction variants of one program
Root layout: Table at user_data 8 and 9 (1 SGPR each, s8, s9), Descriptor at 10 (s10:s11), ResourceHeap at 12.
  s_mov sT.lo, s9 ; s_mov sT.hi, 0                      ; table pointer A
  s_or sB.w1, s11, 0x10000 ; s_mov sB.w0, s10 ; s_mov sB.w2, -1 ; s_mov sB.w3, <format const>   ; buffer descriptor built from root descriptor (CBV)
  s_buffer_load_dword sX, sB, 0                         ; one dword of the root CBV...
  s_mov s9, 0                                           ; ...then s[8:9] = {Table 8, 0} becomes table pointer B
  several s_load_dwordx4 from sT+k and sTableB+k, then s_buffer_loads from those descriptors
  s_buffer_load_dword sY, sDesc, sOff                   ; sOff = a dword read earlier from a CBV (dynamic offset from memory)
  ... vector math, v_cmp_le_f32 |x|,|y|,|z| <= 0.5 combined with s_and_b64, then s_and_saveexec
  s_cbranch_execz                                       ; <- failure reported here
  s_load_dwordx8 sR, s[8:9], +large offset              ; image descriptor from table B inside the masked block
Hypothesis: the scalar-memory value used as data is sOff (CBV dword used as soffset of another s_buffer_load) or sX. Exact faulting read site not known, only the stop offset.
